posts.text:
I have a lot of problems with the media industry but one thing that always reminds me why we do this is when someone working hard behind the scenes gets their due.

So happy for Mark Bartelstein and Andy Shiffman of @PrioritySports. You don’t do it for the fame but take a bow.


Shams Charania (@ShamsCharania)
